summary: December 2021 board extract on local operations. It sets out the post-brand operating model, the integration workstreams and the decisions reserved to the board. Local scientific sign-off and legacy project identifiers stay with each firm.

title_block.title: Board extract: local operations
title_block.subtitle: Extract from the board pack, December 2021 meeting
lines: Prepared by: Dr E. Vellacombe, Group Chair

blocks.p: This extract records the board's position on how the group's local operations are run now that the Tarnovell brand and group template are in use. It covers the operating model, the workstreams still in progress and the decisions reserved to the board.
Legacy records have not been restyled. Where a firm still uses its own template or project numbers, that is intended and is not a gap in the integration.
The integration programme is called One Group, Many Practices. It is active. Local scientific operations are retained in each firm while shared processes converge on group standards.

list: Scientific leadership stays with the local site head
Shared services (finance, HR, IT, quality policy) are run from head office
Commercial pricing is set centrally, with local discounts recorded as history
Client-facing documents may use the common master from the date of brand migration

blocks.p: Each firm keeps its own accession and project numbering. The group does not renumber historical work.

rows: Vellacombe Discovery begins as an independent medicinal chemistry laboratory
Vellacombe becomes the platform for further acquisitions
Biology, DMPK, computational and analytical businesses join, each keeping its local scientific and filing practice
Private equity investment funds the next phase and a common commercial identity
The Tarnovell brand and group template launch. Legacy records are not restyled

blocks.p: The five firms above are the group at the date of this extract. Firms A to E use the common master for client-facing documents.
The board reviewed each workstream against the December plan. Status is as reported by the workstream owners.

rows: Three of five integrated firms mapped. Historical local currencies and discounts are retained.
Firms A to E use the common master. Some legacy signed records still carry earlier client names.
Common export dictionary agreed. Local accession numbers are retained.
Client identity bridge in progress. Subsidiary and lookalike checks are required before any joint approach.
All five firms are in the consolidated directory. Leaver dates are recorded there.
Local shares are kept as archive roots. Leaver folders need an owner check before they are moved.
table.caption: Table 3 Workstream status, December 2021

blocks.p: The board confirmed that release of scientific reports stays with the firm's own quality lead. Group quality sets the common standard but does not sign individual reports.
Reports issued from a legacy template keep that template. Reissuing a historical report in the new brand needs the original signatory's agreement.

list: Group policy and audit: Group Quality Director
Commercial terms: Group Commercial Director, with local input

blocks.p: The following decisions remain reserved to the board and may not be delegated to a firm or to a workstream:

list: Any change to the group template or brand standard
Acquisition or disposal of a firm
Any move of a firm's historical records out of its local share

blocks.p: Other matters are delegated to the Group Chief Executive and reported at the next meeting.

rows: Complete price mapping for the remaining two firms
Finish client identity bridge for the cross-sell pilot
Owner check on leaver folders before any move
